description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for filtering search results related to employee dependents in the HRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for employee number, name, and relationship type, along with getter and setter methods. The class also specifies allowed sort fields and initializes the default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO for specifying search filter parameters for employee dependents, including filtering by name, employee number, and relationship type, with sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'd.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number as an integer or null.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name filter as a string or null.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the relationship type filter as a string or null.
